article.story: DAYTON, Ohio -- — Tim Ibukunoluwa scored 23 points as Siena beat Dayton 99-89 on Tuesday. Ibukunoluwa also added seven rebounds for the Saints (2-1). Brendan Coyle scored 21 points and added seven rebounds and three steals. Trent Egbiremolen shot 4 of 12 from the field and 12 for 12 from the line to finish with 20 points, while adding nine rebounds and three steals. Aiden Derkack finished with 25 points, 10 rebounds, four assists and three steals for the Flyers (1-2). Dayton also got 21 points from Tristian Ford. Amael L’Etang also had nine points and three blocks. Egbiremolen scored 18 points in the second half to help lead Siena to a 10-point victory. Up next Both teams play on Saturday. Siena hosts Brown and Dayton hosts Cincinnati. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
